correctness.rationale: The exact character expansion by subsets of a frequency graph counts partitions of contracted components; all terms with at least three selected edges vanish modulo eight. An eight-dimensional Stirling-residue operator proves the needed 24-periodicity via one explicit vector identity and a six-step orbit; the resulting residue table gives exact 2-adic valuations and convolution ranks. The standalone all-integer checker independently validates 2,131,018 complete small-dimension coefficients and 1,026 eight-vertex signed sums. No numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The Fourier eigenvalue at a frequency graph is a signed sum over every equivalence relation. No equivalent signed all-frequency formula or dyadic rank theorem appears in the inspected two full texts. Nearby indexed small-support Walsh results have different supports and cannot directly imply it.

value.rationale: Binary incidence of equivalence relations is a canonical support of Bell-number size inside the complete edge cube; even support size alone cannot decide Fourier invertibility. Exact global spectral valuations and full inversion on eleven dimension residue classes, including even-cardinality supports, are structural harmonic invariants; the exceptional class retains a uniform half-rank guarantee. All-dimensional classification and rank consequences are mathematically motivated and not an arbitrary finite cut.
